title: Ruth and Frank Stanton Professor in Urban Policy and Planning, Emeritus
affiliation: Ruth and Frank Stanton Professor in Urban Policy and Planning, Emeritus
bio: Alan A. Altshuler is Ruth and Frank Stanton Professor of Urban Policy and Planning. At the Kennedy School, he has been Academic Dean, Director of the A. Alfred Taubman Center for State and Local Government, and Director of the Rappaport Institute for Greater Boston.
